rows.en: ...But a database, now that's a good idea. I wanted intel on the enemy myself.
You're awfully eager, aren't you?
'Cause I've got no intention of croaking in a world like this.
Taro's better now, and we've gained more reliable allies, too.
The "power" of every world... And the "plan"...
Something seems to be lurking in this Cube that's beyond anything we've seen so far.
Can't you find out anything through Veda?
...No. As I said before, this world's Veda doesn't seem to have a grasp of everything.
Veda itself seems to be actively gathering information as well, but
...I see. So the only ones we can trust are ourselves.
Yes. In the end, nothing beats the information we get by actually infiltrating the Cubes.
areas where the enemy's forces are strong look difficult for it.
Accel and Birth infiltrated with the separate unit too, right?
I wonder if they're all right... I hope they aren't still feeling the damage from before.
Huh, so they're putting high-end items and powerful monsters on display.
...But who are they showing them off to, I wonder?
Apparently the enemy's top brass come by to size them up.
Hey, are your weapons on display there too?
I don't think mine are. I've already got all of them back.
The enemy's keen on Medal research, too. I'd better study up... Ankh, teach me all about them, okay?
...Hah? Look that kind of stuff up yourself.
Even I looked up what I know about the Ultra world and the Gundam world on my own.
That is, if you don't wanna get killed by some enemy you know nothing about.
You got the Core Medals back! Congratulations!
But that "Shocker Greeed" thing has me worried.
...If Shocker's technology has fused with the power of the Medals, it's going to be really tough.
By the way, have you found the "Xtreme Memory"?
Arche Gundam showed up!?
Yeah. Looks like he was hauling out GN Drive Taus.
Hauling them where?
Beats me. I don't know that much.
This is bad...
What exactly is this GN Drive Tau thing?
Ah... Well, it's...
No, forget it. I'll look it up myself. There's that database, right?
Yes. Sorry about that.
Wanting to learn about worlds you don't know is a fine desire, too.
I heard you got a Key Ring? Now you should be able to open all sorts of doors, right?
I hope you find the "Xtreme Memory" soon, too.
"Gaia Impact"...?
It's definitely a scary plan, but... it'll be okay!!
You got the Xtreme Memory too, didn't you?
I know you all can do it!!
So the enemy's "plan" was the "Gaia Impact."
But that was something from W's world...
What would be the point of doing it in this world...?
Phew... Accel's finally settled down and is focusing on recovering.
He's that badly hurt, and he still keeps trying to head out, saying "I can still fight."
The "Gaia Impact" they speak of is...
erasing everything in our original worlds that is "unnecessary to Regis."
That's why they were siphoning "Earth's memories" from the Gaia Gates leading to each world!
We can't let them push the plan any further.
Only two Gaia Gates left... We have to stop them no matter what!!
Hey, listen! Accel's been moaning in his sleep!
Things like "Let's shake it off!" and "Despair is your goal!"
So when I asked him, "Are you okay?"...
he went, "Don't ask me!!" Can you believe it!!
Heh. That guy's fighting something even in his dreams.
...Only one Gaia Gate remains.
The enemy will throw everything they have at us, but I'm counting on you to stop the Gaia Impact.
The enemy is sure to target this place next. Please, you have to stop that particle cannon from firing.
I've deployed a "Capture Cube" around the base.
Its effectiveness is unknown, though. Don't expect too much of it.
In any case, nothing will matter unless the particle cannon is destroyed. I'm counting on you!
That should protect us from the particle cannon to some extent, but...
What!? The Psycho Gundam punched a hole in the Cube's wall?
Yeah. And it's not just any Psycho Gundam... It's the Mk-II.
...So it's a stronger type than before. Isn't there some way you can avoid fighting it?
We have to go through that hole into the Ride Dungeon and smash the particle cannon's turret.
That thing's bound to come out. We'll probably end up fighting it.
I see... Then it can't be helped. But please, don't push yourselves too hard.
Yeah.
I just finished checking the facilities.
There don't seem to be any obvious problems. We were lucky it wasn't a direct hit.
...So, did you go to the Terminal Unit?
From the look of you, I guess not yet.
Leave the base to us. You all get back to your mission, okay?
So the Psycho Gundam Mk-II's blast tilted the Cube and threw the particle cannon's aim off a bit?
It was chance. We only escaped a direct hit because we got lucky.
Still, this taught us something. By my calculations, if we take a direct hit of the same power...

notes.note: No script plays #0.313/377/413-416/427/428/446-450/460/485-489 (nor #0.352, #0.383-387): leftover lines not called by any Talk01_*.bla. Feminine speech, so voiced as Methuss, the Shop host.
Talk01_33 plays #0.319 -> #0.322 -> #0.320 -> #0.321. #0.319 runs on into #0.322 (Seravee: Veda gathers info itself, but enemy-held areas are hard for it); cut at the same point. 'It' = Veda.
Hikari replying to #0.322: 'the only thing we can trust is ourselves'.
Seravee's continuation of #0.319 (played right after it); lowercase start because it completes that sentence.
Exhibit = Monster Zoo display (talk_007 'exhibit room'). 'Kanbu class' -> 'top brass'; 'shinasadame' -> 'size them up'.
Zeta: 'mou zenbu motteru' = he already has all his weapons; 'back' added since the heroes lost their power.
Talk01_36 skips #0.352 (plays #0.351 then #0.353). Ankh's line by content; #0.353 still follows #0.351 as a conditional tag ('That is, if...').
'He' = Arche Gundam (Ali, g=m). GN Drive Tau per glossary; plural is a guess (the source does not mark number).

#0.383-387 are not played by Talk01_38 (it ends at #0.382). Speakers inferred: Ankh asks (#0.383/385, matching his 'look it up yourself' stance and the database in #0.301), Seravee starts to explain and apologises (#0.384/386). #0.387 'desire' line: speaker uncertain (Seravee remarking on Ankh, or OOO); kept speaker-neutral.
Trailing line continues into #0.419. 'W-tachi no sekai' -> 'W's world'.
Completes #0.429's sentence; lowercase start. Regis = alliance (g=n).
'Hoshi no kioku' written with Earth kanji -> glossary 'Earth's memories', quotes kept.
'Unasareteru' = moaning/talking in his sleep from a nightmare.
Accel catchphrases per glossary: furikiru ze -> 'Let's shake it off!'; zetsubou ga omae no goal da -> 'Despair is your goal!'.
Accel's 'ore ni shitsumon suru na' per glossary 'Don't ask me.' Sentence continues from #0.448; lowercase start.
Unscripted male reply ('Fu', '...no sa'): hard-boiled tone suggests W (Shotaro); kept speaker-neutral.
Talk01_43 plays #0.462 -> #0.465 -> #0.463 -> #0.464, so #0.465's trailing 'but...' leads into #0.463. Capture Cube follows story slices.
'Houtou' = the particle cannon's turret (glossary UI 'Gun Turret'); 'gun' dropped to fit the box.
'Yatsu' = the Psycho Gundam Mk-II; 'that thing'/'it' (no pilot named).
Hikari's inference ('...kuruwaseta ka'). Literally the explosion affected the angle of the Cube itself, slightly throwing off the cannon's aim; 'tilted the Cube' compresses it to fit.
Script speaker is Mebius (CHARA_NAME 14) though the plain 'guuzen sa' register is casual for him; kept the script speaker, plain earnest tone.
Sentence runs into #0.495 (Capture Cube can't fully block it); cut at the same point.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers from tools/talkspk.py Shop. GN Drive Taus plural is a guess. No new glossary names (Capture Cube, Terminal Unit, Psycho Gundam Mk-II, GN Drive Tau follow earlier slices).
